content.title: About
content.content: The Chocolate Coated Cereal Bar NFS combines whole grains, nuts and dried fruit, covered with a layer of milk chocolate. It is designed as a quick snack that provides energy through carbohydrates and healthy fats.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The bar contains whole grains such as oats and whole wheat, preserving most of the dietary fiber.
The chocolate coating is made with cocoa butter rather than vegetable oils, enhancing taste and texture.
It often includes sunflower and pumpkin seeds, which are rich in magnesium and zinc.
NFS (Not From Scratch) indicates minimal processing of the ingredients.
Each bar is individually wrapped, making it convenient for travel and active lifestyles.

items.title: Energy support
items.content: A mix of complex carbs and simple sugars in the chocolate coating quickly replenishes glycogen stores.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole grains and dried fruit provide dietary fiber that supports normal digestion.

items.title: Healthy fats
items.content: Nuts and seeds supply monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids beneficial for heart health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Grains are a source of B1, B2 and niacin, which aid metabolic processes.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: Contains magnesium, iron and zinc, supporting muscle function and the immune system.

items.title: Nut and seed allergy
items.content: The product contains nuts and seeds that may trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: The chocolate coating adds simple sugars, so people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: The bar is relatively calorie‑dense; excessive consumption may contribute to weight gain.

items.title: Gluten presence
items.content: Contains wheat, making it unsuitable for individuals with celiac disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The bar can be eaten straight from the wrapper as a quick snack. It can also be sliced and added to yogurt, oatmeal, or used as a sweet element in baked goods.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, consume within 7‑10 days. Discard if a rancid odor develops.
